'''Kea Ki Trang''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who worked as part of the security detail for [[Palisade Starport Control]] on [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. During the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kea Ki Trang had worked at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and was on duty when the luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Asaari Wind]]'', under the false identification ''Spiraling Shape'' tried to blast away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="FP" />
